title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Service Agent in Microsoft 365 as a dedicated service specialist
summary: The roadmap facts, Public Preview billing, prerequisites and documented blocking controls are supported. Minor corrections should clarify the unpublished hiring audience and cite the API overview that establishes how catalog packages represent agents.

claims.claim: The Public Preview licensing model is consumption, billed via Copilot Credits.

claims.claim: The agent account, email address and persistent Microsoft 365 resource access cost 100 Copilot Credits per agent per month in Public Preview.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Agent activity is billed consumptively in addition to the recurring resource charge.

claims.claim: The admin UI path is Microsoft 365 admin center > Agents > All agents > select an agent > Block.
claims.quote: Select Agents > All agents. In the All agents page, select an agent from the list of agents. In the agent details pane that opens, immediately under the agent's name, select Block or Unblock.
